review.A: REJECT: repeated detached vaulted hats; incomplete roof-ground continuity
review.B: REJECT: courtyard principle differs, but vault units repeat and upper masses appear detached
review.C: CONTINUE_FOR_SPATIAL_VERIFICATION: a single grounded stepped arch body contains civic rooms whose roofs are the next urban grounds. Not a mountain repetition or inclined plate. Risks: heavy facade, terraced-gate monumentality, deep interior and insufficient transformation. Central art review pending.
